subject: Downloading rstan package without immediately installing

messages.author: a8b6459b77c849fe
messages.subject: Downloading rstan package without immediately installing
parts:
The current installation procedure for RStan given in the documentation is to execute these two lines:

    source('http://mc-stan.org/rstan/install.R', echo = TRUE, max.deparse.length = 2000)
    install_rstan()

Is there a way to just download the rstan package itself and install it at a later time? I'm trying to create an installation package that has everything needed (R, RTools, RStan) all together in one place, with a known, specific version of RStan.
